title: onCellValueChanged fires before changeSet is updated, so handlers read stale data
combination: String column **Make editable** on; **On cell value changed** event → Show alert / Run query that reads `components.table1.changeSet`
steps: Table on a blank canvas. Inspector → **Data**, paste:
Inspector → **Table Columns** → **name** → **Make editable** on.
Events → **+ Add handler** → **On cell value changed** → action **Show alert**, message `{{JSON.stringify(components.table1.changeSet)}}`.
Edit row 1 name from `N1` to `Zed` and click another cell.
expected: The alert shows `{"0":{"name":"Zed"}}`, the change that triggered the event.
actual: The alert shows `{}`. The event fires before changeSet is updated, so an auto-save query (the main use of this event) sends the previous state and the current edit is missing.
evidence: onCellValueChanged fired 1× with message "CELL:{}" (V10-events.cy.js). By contrast onBulkUpdate reads {"0":{"name":"A1"}} and onPageChanged/onSearch/onSort read fresh values.

title: Excel and PDF exports ignore the search and write blank, raw or [object Object] values
combination: **Show download button** on; search `Ada` active; columns: nested `city.name`, Select (red → Red), JSON, Date Picker (display DD-MMM-YYYY)
steps: Table on a blank canvas. Inspector → **Data**, paste:

Configure **city** with Key `city.name`, **status** as **Select** (options Red/red, Green/green, Blue/blue), **meta** as **JSON**, **joined** as **Date Picker** with Date format `DD-MMM-YYYY` and Parse format `YYYY-MM-DD`.
Type `Ada` into the search box. One row remains on screen.
Download icon → **Download as Excel**, then **Download as PDF**, and open both files.
expected: One row (Ada) with the values as shown on screen: `NY`, `Red`, the JSON text, `15-Mar-2024`.
actual: Both files contain **all 3 rows**. CITY is empty, STATUS is the stored value (`red`), META is `[object Object]` and JOINED is the raw `2024-03-15`. The PDF text reads `1 Ada red [object Object] 2024-03-15 / 2 Grace … / 3 Alan …`. These are the same defects as the CSV export.
evidence: xlsx sheet1: ID|NAME|CITY|STATUS|META|JOINED / 1|Ada||red|[object Object]|2024-03-15 / 2|Grace||green|… / 3|Alan||blue||2025-07-20; PDF text identical (V11-download-container-edits.cy.js, parsed offline)
note: The XLSX also omits `docProps/core.xml`. That is valid, but older readers such as node-xlsx fail to open the file, which is why the earlier automated Excel check crashed.

title: The Add new row popup shows validation errors on a blank row before the user types anything
combination: **Show add new row button** on; Select and Tags with a required-style **Custom rule**; Date Picker with **Minimum date**
steps: Table on a blank canvas. Inspector → **Data**, paste:

Give **s** (Select) the Custom rule `{{value ? '' : 'Pick one'}}`, **t** (Tags) `{{value?.length ? '' : 'Add a tag'}}`, and **d** (Date Picker, DD/MM/YYYY) **Minimum date** `01/01/2027`. Make all editable.
Turn on **Show add new row button** and click **+**.
expected: A fresh, untouched row shows no errors. Errors appear after the user interacts with a field or tries to save.
actual: All three fields are red immediately: **Pick one**, **Add a tag**, and **Minimum date is 01/01/2027** on an empty date (a blank date is reported as being before the minimum). Picking 15/09/2026, before the minimum, is still written to newRows.
evidence: popupVal:s/t/d empty → invalid with messages; after picking 15/09/2026 newRows d "15/09/2026" (V11)

title: A Select default option is shown in cells and the new-row popup but never stored
combination: Select column, options Red/Green/Blue, **Green** marked as the default option; **Make editable** on; **Show add new row button** on
steps: Table on a blank canvas. Inspector → **Data**, paste:
Inspector → **Table Columns** → **def** → **Select**, options Red/red, Green/green, Blue/blue. Open the Green option and turn on **Make this option as default**. Turn on **Make editable**.
Bind Text components to `{{JSON.stringify(components.table1.updatedData)}}` and `{{JSON.stringify(components.table1.newRows)}}`.
Look at row 1. Then click **+** in the footer and look at the def field in the popup.
expected: Either the default is actually applied (the popup row's def is `"green"` in newRows), or the UI shows the true value (empty) for existing null rows.
actual: The existing row shows **Green** while its data and updatedData are `null`, so the screen disagrees with what is stored. In the add-row popup, Green appears preselected, but newRows has `"def": ""`, so saving inserts an empty value while the user believes Green was chosen.
evidence: default:existing null row → cell "Green", updatedData [{"def":null}]; default:new row → cell "Green", newRows [{"def":""}] (V9b-button-default.cy.js)

title: No warning when Min length is larger than Max length
combination: String column, **Make editable** on, **Min length** 5, **Max length** 2
steps: Table on a blank canvas. Inspector → **Data**, paste:
Inspector → **Table Columns** → **s** → **String**, **Make editable** on, **Min length** `5`, **Max length** `2`.
Look at the validation fields in the column popover.
expected: The inspector flags the impossible range, since no value can ever satisfy it.
actual: No warning or error is shown on either field. Every value becomes invalid in the table, and only the Min length message ever appears, so the builder has no hint the configuration is contradictory.
evidence: conflict:s → no error/warning elements in the popover (V12b-inspector.cy.js); cell shows only "Minimum 5 characters is needed" (V3 s-min-gt-max)

title: Rating's Default rating field shows 3, but no default is applied
combination: Rating column; **Default rating** left as shown
steps: Table on a blank canvas, add a **Rating** column.
Open it in **Table Columns** and read **Default rating**: it shows `3`.
Turn on **Show add new row button**, click **+**, and read `{{JSON.stringify(components.table1.newRows)}}`.
expected: If the field shows 3, new rows start at 3 stars. If 3 is only a placeholder, it should look like one (greyed, e.g. "e.g. 3").
actual: The `3` is only placeholder text, so nothing is applied. New rows get `""` (and an explicit Default rating of 4 is ignored too). The field looks filled in but has no effect.
evidence: inspector:rating shows "Default rating","3" (V12b); popup:initialNewRows crating "" with defaultRating {{4}} (V7)

title: The Number column's Regex example accepts letters and spaces
steps: Add a **Number** column, turn on **Make editable**.
Read the placeholder in the **Regex** field.
expected: A numeric example (e.g. `^\d+$`), or no Regex field for Number columns.
actual: The placeholder is `/^[\w\s\d]+$/i`, a pattern for letters, digits and spaces, copied from the String column. Builders who copy it get a rule that allows text in a number column.
evidence: inspector:number:properties(editable on) shows the Regex placeholder /^[\w\s\d]+$/i (V12b)

title: Clear filters and the filter-row x do not remove filters: the table stays filtered
combination: **Enable filtering** on; one filter applied (name contains N2)
steps: Table on a blank canvas. Inspector → **Data**, paste:
Bind a Text component to `{{JSON.stringify(components.table1.filters)}}`.
Filter icon → **+ Add filter** → **name** → **contains** → `N2`. One row remains.
Open the filter panel, click the **x** on that filter row and close the panel. Then add a filter again and try **Clear filters** instead.
expected: All 4 rows return and `filters` becomes `[]`. **On filter changed** fires.
actual: The panel empties, but the table still shows 1 row and `filters` still holds the old condition after both **x** and **Clear filters**. The applied filter only changes when another filter value is typed, so users cannot un-filter the table and anything bound to `filters` stays stale. No **On filter changed** event fires, because the applied filters never change.
evidence: after removing the filter row (x): rows 1, filters [{contains N2}]; after Clear filters: rows 1, filters [{contains N3}] (V13b-filterclear.cy.js). Consistent with Part 1 A4-filter failure "clear all restores all rows: found 1, expected 2"

title: On table data download never fires with client-side pagination
combination: **On table data download** event → Show alert; default client-side pagination
steps: Table on a blank canvas. Inspector → **Data**, paste:
Events → **+ Add handler** → **On table data download** → **Show alert**.
Click the download icon → **Download as CSV**, then **Download as Excel**.
expected: The event fires on each download, as the event list offers it for every table.
actual: The files download but the event never fires. It is only wired when **Server-side pagination** is on, where it replaces the download menu entirely. On a normal table the handler is dead, with no hint in the inspector.
evidence: onTableDataDownload fired 0× after CSV and Excel downloads (V13-closeout.cy.js)

title: Link, Rating and Image columns have no Cell colour option
combination: Column Styles tab for Link, Rating, Image vs other types
steps: Add columns of type **String**, **Link**, **Rating** and **Image**.
Open each one in **Table Columns** → **Styles**.
expected: Every column type can set its cell background (String, Number, Boolean, Button and others have **Cell color**).
actual: Link offers text alignment, text colour and underline options only; Rating offers alignment and star colours; Image offers alignment, border radius and fit. None of them has **Cell color**, so rows that use cell colouring (e.g. status highlighting) cannot colour these columns. Image fit also shows `Select..` although the runtime default is Contain.
evidence: styles-tab:link [Text alignment, Text color, Underline color, Show underline]; styles-tab:rating [Alignment, Selected color, Unselected color]; styles-tab:image [Alignment, Border radius, Image fit, Select..] (V13-closeout.cy.js)
